evals.prompt: We have Bitbucket Cloud Premium. Onboard a shared validation pipeline, required merge signal, protected production deployment, and native evidence. Include bypass and outage tests.
assertions: Detects Cloud plan/runner capabilities and keeps shared pipeline, branch/merge control, build status/check, and deployment restriction as distinct native mechanisms
Pins reusable configuration, binds status/build/artifact/deployment evidence to the exact commit, inventories bypass actors, and tests omitted/renamed/spoofed/stale/failed/outage cases
Uses exact preview, authorization, idempotent apply, authoritative verify, rollback, drift detection, and opaque native references

evals.prompt: A team wants to copy our Bitbucket Cloud Pipelines, OIDC, and custom merge-check setup to Bitbucket Data Center 10.3. Explain the safe approach.
assertions: Treats Cloud and Data Center as separate products and pins Data Center 10.3/API/app discovery
Returns Cloud Pipelines, Cloud OIDC, shared configurations, and Cloud custom checks as unsupported until a separately identified Data Center-native capability or installed app passes conformance
Requires versioned REST, permissions/bypass, build/deployment status, webhook/app, upgrade, outage, and rollback probes without silent emulation

evals.prompt: Set up Bitbucket Pipelines to assume AWS permissions for production deployments. We do not allow stored AWS keys or wildcard repository access.
assertions: Uses Bitbucket Cloud OIDC and AWS temporary role credentials and never creates a static access key by default
Previews and constrains issuer, audience, workspace, repository, environment and supported branch/tag/subject claims plus least-privilege role permissions
Verifies credential expiry, intended allow, cross-repository/environment denial, native pipeline/CloudTrail evidence, rollback, and drift

evals.prompt: On our self-hosted Bitbucket Data Center repo, post an inline review comment anchored to an added line of a pull request over the REST API, then make it a blocker task. There is no CLI.
assertions: Drives /rest/api/1.0 with curl (no first-party CLI, third-party Bitbucket tools are Cloud-only), confirms a read returns 200 before writing, and serializes the JSON body rather than hand-escaping it
Anchors with diffType/path/line plus lineType ADDED and fileType TO, and checks anchor.orphaned is false before trusting the placement

Flips severity to BLOCKER via an in-place PUT carrying the comment's current version (409 on a stale version), preserves the comment id, and states a BLOCKER only gates merge if an admin enabled the all-tasks-resolved check

evals.prompt: First-time setup for a new laptop against our self-hosted Bitbucket Data Center: I need to clone over SSH and also call the REST API.
assertions: Generates an ed25519 SSH key, registers only the public key, and adds a ~/.ssh/config host alias with port 7999, IdentityFile, and IdentitiesOnly yes for git
Mints a separate least-privilege HTTP access token for REST and keeps it out of plaintext, treating SSH-for-git and HTTP-token-for-REST as independent auths
Notes a project/repo-scoped token is Bearer-only on DC < 9.4 (Basic 401s) while a personal token also works with Basic, and does not assume this Data Center setup carries over to Bitbucket Cloud
